blueprintSignals.name: Field confidence
blueprintSignals.definition: calibrated probability that each extracted field is correct
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Calibrate per field type, as amounts and dates differ

blueprintSignals.name: Appetite match
blueprintSignals.definition: match of class, size and geography to the underwriting appetite rules
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Appetite rules change often, so version them

blueprintSignals.name: Loss run totals
blueprintSignals.definition: sum of paid and incurred losses parsed from the loss runs
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Parsing errors change the total, so compare with the printed total

blueprintSignals.name: Missing data count
blueprintSignals.definition: number of required fields absent from the submission
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: The definition of required varies by class

label: For "Commercial Insurance Submission Intake & Risk Extraction": Read broker submissions (emails, ACORD forms, spreadsheets, loss runs) and extract structured risk data so underwriters can quote faster. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Clean test submissions are better formatted than live ones.
